checklist.desc: Specs: battery, Bluetooth version/codecs, multipoint, weight, wired options (3.5mm aux, USB-C lossless), included cables.
Pairing procedure from the owner's guide as STEP claims.
The Bluetooth device name ('BOSE QC ULTRA 2 HP') as a SPEC claim.

COMPATIBILITY claims for MacBook pairing (wired via 3.5mm; Bluetooth) ONLY if a source on either side states it; otherwise record as a gap with kind UNDERIVABLE — that is an acceptable, important finding.
